purpose: The single source of truth for which model files the offline bundle may contain, and what bytes each one must be. Read by resolve_model.py; never by a demo directly.

bundle_layout.root_default_provenance: deploy/syntriass/README.md section 3 installs to /opt/syntriass/releases/<commit> and repoints /opt/syntriass/current

integrity_rule: SHA-256 is the authoritative check and subsumes size. A file whose digest differs from the pinned value is not the pinned artifact and is refused; it is never used with a warning.
provenance_rule: An entry whose source_url or licence is UNVERIFIED_NO_NETWORK must NOT be downloaded by the staging script. Integrity without provenance is not enough to put a model in a customer bundle.

models.size_provenance: research/compute-memory/BASELINES.md:21 — documented in MiB, not exact bytes; not used as a check
models.note: BASELINES.md:25 records that despite the Q4_K_M name this file is mostly Q5_0/Q8_0 tensors per its GGUF metadata.
The model every published v0.2 figure was measured with.

not_yet_pinned.reason: Requested models whose licence could not be read from their model card: huggingface.co answers 403 at this environment's proxy, so no model card is reachable. Adding them with a licence recalled from memory would defeat the point of the check.

not_yet_pinned.what_is_needed: Read each model card on a connected machine and record, per file: the exact repository and file URL, the SHA-256 of the file as downloaded, and the licence identifier as the card states it. A licence restricting commercial use stops the entry and is escalated.
not_yet_pinned.tracked_as: Owner-tracked. Blocked until a connected machine can read each model card; resolve_model.py's `provenance` subcommand exits 5 for any entry whose source_url or licence is UNVERIFIED_NO_NETWORK, so a staging script cannot download one by accident.
